metadata.title: Vertical Triptych Portrait with Interlocking Geometric Header

retrievalProfile.description: Use for multi-subject portraits divided into vertical panels with a large, custom-lettered header that overlaps the top of the frame.

recipe.visualDefinition: A composition featuring four vertical panels, each containing a high-contrast monochrome portrait of a different individual, topped by a large, interlocking geometric title and a secondary sans-serif subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical panel divisions create a rhythmic repetition across the frame
The large header anchors the top third and overlaps the photographic subjects
High-contrast lighting on faces creates a unified tonal range across different panels
The subtitle acts as a horizontal bridge across the vertical seams
coreInvariants: Interlocking geometric letterforms in the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects are tightly cropped, filling their respective vertical panels from chest to crown.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, red-outlined interlocking title at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold title down through the vertical panels, scanning faces from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with portraits and graphic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark shadows and highlights within the photography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm red for the primary title outlines
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in imagery contrasted with high-value graphic outlines.

letterConstructionRules: The first letter is enclosed in a circular frame
Sharp, angular terminals and extended horizontal bars
Consistent stroke weight with a thin interior inline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'O' functions as a containing ring for the subsequent letter
Final 'K' features an extended leg that mirrors the 'Z' angle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Custom geometric display lettering paired with a clean, widely-spaced block sans-serif.

preserve: Interlocking nature of the top text
avoid: Overly bright colors in the photography

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric basis for the custom lettering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate four vertical panels of monochrome, high-contrast male portraits with beards, lit from the side to create deep shadows. Ensure the panels are seamlessly aligned.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, red-outlined interlocking geometric title at the top, with the first letter inside a circle. Below it, add a widely-spaced white sans-serif subtitle.

verificationChecks: Are there four distinct vertical panels?
Is the primary title interlocking and outlined in red?
Is the photography monochrome or sepia-toned?
Does the subtitle span across the panel seams?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific band names or logos
Ensure the faces are generic and not recognizable celebrities

mustAchieve: Consistent lighting across all portrait panels

postGenerationChecks: Verify red outline on top text
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Panel Portraits + Interlocking Geometric Header + Wide-Tracked Subtitle
